requirements.description: User explicitly wants the building near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.
The student residence project type clearly requires proximity to universities and schools. Value set to the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through C.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The capacity of 60 people, the energy class, and the public transport proximity are not mapped to REFERENCE COLUMNS and are not converted into filters. The city 'Turin' is a geographic reference handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices (tipologia_bene_immobile mapped to its canonical column property_type, since the legacy name is not in filterable_columns) with surface_area >= 850, energy_class A1-A4/B/C, education >= 75, mobility >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance to that point. No LIMIT applied.
